title: Art. 13.6.1 — Annex 6 - Operation of Aircraft, Part I - International Commercial Air Transport - Aeroplanes, Chapter 13 - Security, 13.6 Miscellaneous
content: Recommendation. Specialized means of attenuating and directing the blast should be provided for use at the least- risk bomb location.
